name: open_models
description: Three open-weight operator sets run under the Codex CLI on the same 50 objects: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 at medium and at max reasoning effort, and Kimi-K3.1-Pro; graded as the paper round was: three agents A/B/C, 150 simulations per evaluator, three Fable evaluators (run_fable.sh) and three Astra evaluators (astra_high/run_evaluator.sh) reading the same self-contained packets.
label_seed_note: 2029 is the first seed from 2026 on that gives each model a different label for each evaluator (deepseek A/B/C, deepseek_max C/A/B, kimi B/C/A for k = 1, 2, 3): evaluators grade in label order, so every model is graded first, second and third once.
figures_note: Staged copies of the category figures (illustrations/agentic_results/ar_categories.py): DeepSeek medium and Kimi built 2026-11-18; DeepSeek max is added once its batch has finished. The _sonnet figures in the folder belong to a stopped first version of this round (open_models/RUN.md) and are not used.

packet_edits.why: The agent named itself (leak_check.py flags it).

cost_note: Cost: the coding agent's Codex session priced from its token counts with the batch runner's dated price table (metrics.json cost_usd), not a billed amount; n/p: no price for that run (left out of the totals and the mean); the FEM workflow's own API calls are excluded.
